content:

content:
The iPad Air M4 in space gray. | Image: The Verge	

Almost everything with high-end memory or storage is more expensive these days, and tablets are no exception, so we’re glad to see that Amazon and Best Buy have the most recent 11-inch iPad Air with the M4 chip on sale for $649. That’s $100 lower than the new retail price that went into effect (alongside plenty of other Apple price hikes) in June. You can also grab the 256GB model for $749 (usually $849), and the version with a cellular antenna for $799 (usually $899).
Apple iPad Air M4

Where to Buy:

 $749 $649 at Amazon (128GB, Wi-Fi)
 $749 $649 at Best Buy (128GB, Wi-Fi)

We reviewed the M4 iPad Air when it released in March, and found a very similar experience to the previous generation, for better or worse. The upgraded internals give the system a performance boost and better connectivity, like Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 6, but otherwise this update is short on notable or exciting features if you’ve used an iPad Air the past few years.
Read our Apple iPad M4 Air review.

title: OpenAI hit the brakes. Now what?
summary: OpenAI announced it's slowing AI development to strengthen security and safeguards, including pausing reinforcement learning training on its latest models and delaying its largest planned frontier RL run. content:
With a looming IPO, intense competition from Anthropic, and Chinese and open-weight rivals nipping at its heels, OpenAI has plenty of reasons to move fast. Instead, it hit the brakes.
On Tuesday, the company said it had slowed the pace of some AI development while it tightened security and safeguards. That included a two-week pause in reinforcement learning training on its "latest models intended for deployment," and an ongoing delay to its "largest planned frontier RL run."
The decision is a very public test of an idea AI safety advocates have pushed for for years: that companies should be willing to bow out of the AI race and slow things …

In the face of all that flux, Google's Pixel 11 Pro Fold has hardly changed a thing.

title: Framework gave its 12-inch laptop some hardware upgrades
summary: Framework released a second-generation 12-inch convertible laptop with Intel's latest Core Series 3 processors, expanded customization options, and a Linux Fedora pre-load option, starting at $699. Pre-orders are available with deliveries expected in October.
content:
Framework launched a second-generation of its colorful 2-in-1 convertible laptop. | Image: Framework	

Framework has refreshed its 12-inch convertible laptop, introducing Intel's latest Core Series 3 processors, expanded hardware customizations, and a pre-built Linux option. The cheapest pre-built base configuration for the Framework Laptop 12 now starts at $699 - $100 less than the previous version when it launched last year. Preorders are open now, with the first wave of deliveries expected to ship in October.

title: Relativity Networks raises $22 million to bring a faster kind of fiber to data centers
summary: Relativity Networks raised $22 million in funding to deploy hollow-core fiber technology in data centers, enabling data transmission 30% faster than conventional fiber. The rarely-deployed technology addresses critical latency and speed requirements in modern infrastructure.
content: Relativity Networks deals in hollow-core fiber, a rarely deployed technology that allows data to be transmitted 30% faster than conventional fiber.

zh.summary: Relativity Networks募集了2200万美元资金，以在数据中心部署空心光纤技术，使数据传输比传统光纤快30%。这种很少部署的技术解决了现代基础设施中关键的延迟和速度要求。
